ocr.notes: Short and mostly right, but one sentence is wrong: transcript 'it was announced that he would obtain her divorce' (image: 'it was announced that he was to wed the woman when she obtained her divorce'). Also 'dwindled to nothing' (image: 'dwindled almost to nothing'). Subheads not transcribed.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Judge Taylor curtly denied Tillie Hartgrove a divorce from Martin Hartgrove on learning she had been the late Tom Allen's housekeeper; Allen had willed her his property.

facts.fact: Judge Taylor denied Tillie Hartgrove's divorce from Martin Hartgrove when he learned she had been Allen's housekeeper; she testified her husband deserted her less than two weeks after their wedding seven years earlier
Before Allen died it was announced that he was to wed Hartgrove when she obtained her divorce
Allen willed his property to Hartgrove for her services
Allen's estate had dwindled almost to nothing and was still in litigation
